items.title: CNC Q3 deep dive: Medicare and Marketplace margin gains drive improved outlook
items.summary: Health coverage company Centene (NYSE:CNC) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, with sales up 1.9% year on year to $50.65 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $198.5 billion at the midpoint came in 1.3% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.58 per share was significantly above analysts’ consensus estimates.
